Why create a website?

I made this website because I wanted to have a nice platform where I could showcase everything I did and how I did it.

Why do it

I made a GitHub account to share and document my progress. I then realised that GitHub repos might not be best and sleekest ways to do this. Therefore I searched an alternative and then I remembered Mr Péter Zoltán Csurcsia’s website. I then searched how to make website and stumbled upon hugo.
